EXECUTE NOW.

THIS IS A REAL CODE, INFRASTRUCTURE, SECURITY, DEPLOYMENT, AND QA TASK.

DO NOT RETURN ONLY A PLAN.
DO NOT CREATE A SECOND APPLICATION.
DO NOT DELETE WORKING IVX FEATURES.
DO NOT CONVERT THE EXPO APP INTO A WEB-ONLY PRODUCT.
DO NOT REMOVE VALID CODE ONLY BECAUSE RORK ORIGINALLY GENERATED IT.
DO NOT MARK COMPLETE UNTIL THE LIVE SYSTEM HAS ZERO RORK DEPENDENCIES.

FINAL OBJECTIVE

Remove Rork completely from:

- Developer source code
- Expo React Native application
- Android application
- iOS configuration
- Web application
- Public landing page
- IVX Owner AI
- Autonomous workers
- AI gateway
- Backend

- Deployment pipeline

- Credentials
- Network traffic

- Account and collaborator access

IVX must remain operational under owner control.

==================================================

==================================================

1. Freeze unrelated production changes.

3. Create Git tag:

4. Back up:

- Git repository
- Production database schema
- Required production data
- Storage buckets
- Supabase functions
- Supabase policies
- Render environment-variable names
- GitHub Actions
- Expo/EAS configuration
- DNS configuration
- AWS configuration
- Current deployment settings

5. Create a rollback procedure.
6. Verify the backup location.
7. Do not expose raw credentials in the report.

REQUIRED RESULT

ROLLBACK: READY / NOT READY
PRE-REMOVAL COMMIT:
BACKUP TIMESTAMP:
OWNER APPROVAL REQUIRED FOR DESTRUCTIVE ACTIONS: YES

==================================================

==================================================

- Build dependency: yes/no

- Owner-controlled: yes/no

- Verification test

==================================================
PHASE 2 — CLASSIFY BEFORE REMOVING
==================================================

Classify every match as:

A. RORK RUNTIME DEPENDENCY

The system calls or requires Rork during normal operation.

Action:
Replace, test, then remove.

B. RORK BUILD OR DEPLOYMENT DEPENDENCY

Rork is required to build or deploy IVX.

Action:
Replace with owner-controlled GitHub, Render, Expo/EAS, Supabase, or AWS flow.

C. RORK UI OR BRANDING REFERENCE

Rork name, logo, banner, link, update notice, attribution, or project URL.

Action:
Remove from IVX interfaces.

D. IVX CODE ORIGINALLY GENERATED THROUGH RORK

Valid IVX-owned source code with no runtime Rork dependency.

Action:
Keep the code. Remove only the dependency, reference, or control path.

E. SHARED THIRD-PARTY SERVICE

Expo, React Native, Supabase, Render, AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, email, SMS, or another approved provider.

Action:
Keep if owner-controlled and required by IVX.

F. UNKNOWN

Action:
Investigate before modification.

Do not delete unknown components until their runtime use is proven.

==================================================

==================================================

- Production branch is correct.
- Render is connected to the owner repository.

- No Rork-controlled Git remote exists.
- No Git submodule points to Rork.
- No package is loaded from a Rork registry.
- No build script downloads Rork code.
- No deployment pipeline reads from a Rork repository.

Run and return:
